changelog: v1.2.0: Phase 1 Complete. Tabbed Modern Plugin Dashboard, Manual Magnet URI downloading with provider selection (Auto / Seedr / Torbox) & Activity auto-navigation, fallback download routing to configured directory, smooth movie detail button animations & hover transitions, friendly low-peer alert cards, scraper domain auto-discovery status badge & backup mirror override, and language cleanup improvements.
description: Native Downloads ecosystem for Jellyfin. Scrapes external forums for new media and integrates with Seedr and Torbox for downloading.
name: JellyFetch
overview: External media scraper and download manager. Integrates Seedr and Torbox.
